talents.name: Improved Holy Strike
talents.description: Reduces the cooldown of your Holy Strike ability by 1 sec.

talents.name: Divine Strength
talents.description: Increases your Strength by 2%.

talents.name: Divine Intellect
talents.description: Increases your total Intellect by 2%.

talents.name: Healing Light
talents.description: Increases the amount healed by your Holy Light, Flash of Light, and Holy Shock spells by 4%.

talents.name: Spiritual Focus
talents.description: Gives your Flash of Light, Holy Light, and Light's Vigil spells a 35% chance to not lose casting time when you take damage.

talents.name: Improved Seals
talents.description: Increases the damage done by your Seals and Judgements by 5%.

talents.name: Unyielding Faith
talents.description: Reduces the duration of Fear and Disorient effects on you by 15%.

talents.name: Voice of Truth
talents.description: Grants you immunity to Silence and Interrupt effects. Lasts 6 sec.

talents.name: Reverence
talents.description: Allows 10% of your Mana regeneration to continue while casting.

talents.name: Purifying Power
talents.description: Reduces the mana cost of your Cleanse and Purify spells by 10% and reduces the cooldown of your Exorcism and Holy Wrath spells by 17%.

talents.name: Infusion of Light
talents.description: Your Holy Shock and Flash of Light critical hits reduce the cast time of your next Holy Light cast within 15 sec by 0.5 sec.

talents.name: Illumination
talents.description: After getting a critical effect from your Flash of Light, Holy Light, Light's Vigil, or Holy Shock heal spell you have a 20% chance to gain Mana equal to 50% of the base cost of the spell.

talents.name: Divine Favor
talents.description: When activated, gives your next Flash of Light, Holy Light, or Holy Shock spell a 100% critical effect chance.

talents.name: Divine Precision
talents.description: Increases your chance to hit with Holy spells by 6%.

talents.name: Holy Shock
talents.description: Blasts the target with Holy energy, causing 129 to 139 Holy damage to an enemy, or 110 to 118 healing to an ally.

talents.name: Consecrated Ground
talents.description: Gives your Holy spells 5% increased damage against the first 4 enemies that enter your Consecration.

talents.name: Holy Power
talents.description: Increases the critical strike chance of your Holy Shock spell by 3%, and all other spells by 1%.

talents.name: Light's Vigil
talents.description: Applies Light's Vigil to the target for 30 sec. Your next Holy Shock cast on them triggers no cooldown and causes friendly targets to heal their party for 315 to 333, or enemy targets to suffer 175 to 189 Holy damage and refund 75% of Light's Vigil's Mana cost. You may only have 1 Light's Vigil active per Paladin, per party.

talents.name: Toughness
talents.description: Increases your armor value from items by 2%.

talents.name: Redoubt
talents.description: Damaging melee attacks against you have a 10% chance to increase your chance to block by 6%. Lasts 10 sec or 5 blocks.

talents.name: Precision
talents.description: Increases your chance to hit with all spells and attacks by 1%.

talents.name: Guardian's Favor
talents.description: Reduces the cooldown of your Blessing of Protection by 1 min and increases the duration of your Blessing of Freedom by 3 sec.

talents.name: Anticipation
talents.description: Increases your Defense Skill by 4.

talents.name: Improved Seal of Fury
talents.description: When Seal of Fury's shield is fully absorbed, restore 38 Mana, increased by 15% per level the attacker is above you, up to 45%.

talents.name: Improved Righteous Fury
talents.description: While Righteous Fury is active, all damage taken is reduced by 2%.

talents.name: Shield Specialization
talents.description: Increases the amount of damage absorbed by your shield by 10%, and gives your blocks a 33% chance to restore 6% of your maximum Mana. May only occur once every 3 sec.

talents.name: Sacred Duty
talents.description: Increases your total Stamina by 2% and reduces the cooldown of your Divine Shield, Divine Protection, and Templar's Bulwark spells by 30 sec.

talents.name: Swift Judgement
talents.description: Finishes the remaining cooldown on your Judgement ability and reduces the Mana cost of your next Judgement by 100%.

talents.name: One-Handed Weapon Specialization
talents.description: Increases the damage you deal with one-handed melee weapons by 3%.

talents.name: Improved Hammer of Justice
talents.description: Decreases the cooldown of your Hammer of Justice spell by 5 sec.

talents.name: Templar's Bulwark
talents.description: When activated, this ability grants you an absorb shield equal to 100% of your maximum health for 8 sec. Applies Forbearance for 1 min. Cannot be cast while Forbearance is active.

talents.name: Reckoning
talents.description: Gives you a 8% chance to gain an extra attack after Blocking a melee attack and a 20% chance to gain an extra attack after being the victim of a non-periodic critical strike.

talents.name: Iron Creed
talents.description: Increases the threat generated by your Holy Strike ability 5%. While Righteous Fury is active, Holy Strike also reduces your damage taken by 2% for 6 sec.

talents.name: Holy Shield
talents.description: Increases chance to block by 20% for 10 sec, and deals 110 Holy damage for each attack blocked while active. Damage caused by Holy Shield causes 20% additional threat. Each block expends a charge. 4 charges.

talents.name: Deflection
talents.description: Increases your Parry chance by 1%.

talents.name: Benediction
talents.description: Reduces the Mana cost of all instant cast spells and abilities by 2%.

talents.name: Improved Judgement
talents.description: Decreases the cooldown of your Judgement ability by 1 sec.

talents.name: Holy Conduit
talents.description: Reduces the mana cost of your Consecration, Holy Wrath, Exorcism, and Hammer of Wrath spells by 20%.

talents.name: Conviction
talents.description: Increases your chance to get a critical strike with melee attacks by 1%.

talents.name: Vindication
talents.description: Gives your damaging melee attacks a chance to reduce the target's Attack Power by 42, and increase your Attack Power by 1% for 30 sec.

talents.name: Sanctified Judgement
talents.description: Gives your Judgement ability a 33% chance to return 20% of the Mana cost of the judged seal.

talents.name: Seal of Command
talents.description: Gives the Paladin a chance to deal additional Holy damage equal to 70% of normal weapon damage. Only one Seal can be active on the Paladin at any one time. Lasts 30 sec. Unleashing this Seal's energy will judge an enemy, instantly causing 68 to 73 Holy damage, 137 to 146 if the target is stunned or incapacitated.

talents.name: Pursuit of Justice
talents.description: Increases movement speed and mounted movement speed by 8%. This does not stack with other movement speed increasing effects.

talents.name: Eye for an Eye
talents.description: All critical strikes against you cause 5% of the damage taken to the attacker as well. The damage caused by Eye for an Eye will not exceed 50% of the Paladin's total health.

talents.name: Sacred Arbiter
talents.description: Increases the damage of your Holy Strike ability by 10% and causes it to refresh all Judgement effects on the target.

talents.name: Crusade
talents.description: Increases all damage dealt by 1%. Increased by an additional 1% against Demon and Undead targets.

talents.name: Two-Handed Weapon Specialization
talents.description: Increases the damage you deal with two-handed melee weapons by 3%.

talents.name: Vengeance
talents.description: Increases your Physical and Holy damage dealt by 1% for 30 sec after landing a critical strike. Stacks up to 5 times.

talents.name: Repentance
talents.description: Puts the enemy target in a state of meditation, incapacitating them for up to 6 sec. Any damage caused will awaken the target. Only works against Humanoids.

talents.name: Champion of the Light
talents.description: Increases your spell damage and healing by up to 33% of your Intellect.

talents.name: Instrument of Law
talents.description: Reduces the cast time of your Hammer of Wrath by 0.5 sec, and reduces all threat you generate by 10% while Righteous Fury is not active.

talents.name: Twist of Light
talents.description: When you replace your Seal of Command, Seal of Righteousness, Seal of Fury, or Seal of Justice with a different Seal, gain an Echo. Your next melee attack applies the replaced Seal's effects, consuming the Echo.
